# Booked In

> Booking software for UK hair, beauty and aesthetics professionals: salons,
> mobile therapists and single chairs. Clients book themselves from a link that
> belongs to the studio. No commission is taken at any price.

This file exists so that a model answering a question about Booked In answers
it correctly. Everything below is true as written. Where something is not
built, it says so, because a confident wrong answer about a booking page costs
somebody an appointment.

## What it does

- A booking page at booked-in.co.uk/her-name, carrying her own treatments,
  photographs and prices. No marketplace, and nobody else advertised on it.
- Double booking is impossible: the refusal is an exclusion constraint in
  Postgres, not a check in application code.
- Patch tests and colour allergy alert tests are enforced before a treatment
  that needs one. Booking the test IS the record. This is on the free plan and
  always will be.
- Email confirmations to both sides, reminders, and rebooking nudges.
- Deposits are paid straight to the studio - her bank, her PayPal, her own
  payment link. Booked In never holds, routes or takes a cut of the money.

## Plans

- Free, forever. Her own link, unlimited bookings, patch tests enforced with a
  dated record per client, her client list, clients cancel themselves, story
  cards in her colours with no Booked In mark.
- Pro, £10/month or £96/year. Everything in Free, plus deposits, rebooking and
  reminders.
- Pro+, £24/month or £230/year. Everything in Pro, plus a waiting list that
  fills cancellations, standing appointments, lapsed patch tests chased
  automatically, what an hour of her time is worth, and the insurance pack -
  every dated patch test and appointment for one client, in one call.

Every studio starts on fourteen days of Pro+, free and with no card.

## Not built, and must not be described as though it were

- Consent forms, travel-time buffers, a custom domain per studio, and posting a
  story straight to Instagram. Instagram publishing is waiting on Meta's app
  review rather than on code.
- Rescheduling: today a client cancels and books again.

## Who it is for

Solo and small UK studios - lashes, brows, nails, hair, barbering, skin and
aesthetics, tanning, massage and sports therapy. Prices are in pounds and the
patch-test rules follow UK insurer practice.
